charts.title: HIP 8152 b: orbits around HIP 8152
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 8152's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 8152 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 10.75112478343 d

charts.title: HIP 8152 b: its transit
charts.description: HIP 8152 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (3, 30, 97) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 164767175, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 22 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 22 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 22 min early; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 7 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
